edits.old:
When a call has no valid login, no permission for the operation, or names an unknown id
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 respectively
edits.new:
When a call to a provided operation fails its check
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404; which code applies to which failure is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P3-E1030-APP-AC13)

edits.old:
Then the retry follows the retry policy set for the activity and the job record shows each attempt
    Then an activity that times out is not counted as done and the job record shows the timeout
edits.new:
Then the retry behaviour is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P3-E1030-APP-AC14)
    Then the timeout behaviour is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P3-E1030-APP-AC14)

edits.old: Then the job record lists the refused change
edits.new: Then the record of the refused change is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P3-E1030-APP-AC15)

findings.issue: AC13 assigns 401, 403 and 404 to specific failures (no login, no permission, unknown id). The source gives only the three codes, not the mapping.
AC14 states a retry policy, a per-attempt job record and a timeout outcome (not counted as done). None is in the item; these should read Not specified.
AC15 'job record lists the refused change' conflicts with the story's own Not specified run and job record (GAP-2206). It should read Not specified.
